about_the_game:
WHAT'S IN THIS DEMO

Experience GAZAR's core gameplay in two specially designed demo modes that showcase the game's mechanics and how elite enemies create unique threats when working together.

Story Mode: Play through the first planet and unlock the second planet featuring a semi-boss encounter. Get an early taste of the campaign direction with a short preview of the cutscene system.

Infinity Mode: Survive intense waves of enemies while testing your skills across different difficulty levels. Choose from multiple music tracks and backgrounds to customize your experience.

Both modes feature all 5 difficulty levels and include the game's core customization options - key and controller rebinding, controller support, colorblind accessibility, resolution settings, and audio controls. Full localization is available to explore.

Note: The game should run smoothly on Steam Deck (untested), with the exception of leaderboard name entry which requires a keyboard for the moment, you can skip this step when using a controller.

 GAZAR

An unstoppable alien fleet moves from planet to planet, star system to star system, leaving nothing but scorched worlds and extinction behind them. As they advance, space-time distorts around them, causing inhabitants of nearby worlds to age rapidly,time itself becoming a weapon of mass destruction. You are the chosen pilot of the Nova-X, a unique prototype fighter with potential power beyond imagination. Your mission: Master your ship, unlock its full potential and hold the line. The galaxy's last hope rests in your hands.

ABOUT THIS GAME

GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter where you fight against an alien fleet destroying the galaxy. Battle through the Story Mode or test your skills in Infinity Mode with leaderboards. GAZAR delivers non-stop action, stunning visual effects, and dynamic combat.

FEATURES:

EPIC CAMPAIGN

Experience a story mode with cutscenes featuring professional voice acting

Journey through an expansive campaign spanning multiple star systems and witness the        effects of space-time distortion

ENDLESS CHALLENGE

Test your skills in Infinity Mode with 5 escalating difficulty levels

Compete for supremacy on leaderboards 

Face a diverse range of enemies from standard fighters to elite units with specialized abilities

DYNAMIC COMBAT

Discover over 50 unique enemies and learn how to counter them

Unlock the Nova-X's hidden capabilities by destroying asteroids and collecting their concealed power-ups

Encounter the unique synergy system where elite enemies combine abilities for unpredictable challenges

Only by mastering both your ship's capabilities and understanding your enemy can you hope to prevail

BUILT FOR EVERYONE

5 difficulty levels

 Full controller support with customizable button mappin

Complete keyboard-only play support (perfect for laptops)

Ultrawide and multi-resolution support

Colorblind accessibility options

Extensive customization including key rebinding, health bar visibility, and extensive audio controls

Available in 10 languages

UNLOCK AND ACHIEVE

Earn medals for combat prowess and exploration

Complete Steam achievements to showcase your mastery

Track your progress in a dedicated achievements gallery
